SELECT
	record_id,
    CASE transaction_type
        WHEN 'CASH' THEN 0
        WHEN 'DEBIT' THEN 1
        WHEN 'PAYMENT' THEN 2
        WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN 3
	    ELSE -1
    END AS transaction_type,
    actual_days_to_ship,
    scheduled_days_to_ship,
    benefit_per_order,
    sales_per_customer,
    CASE delivery_status
        WHEN 'Advance shipping' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Late delivery' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Shipping canceled' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Shipping on time' THEN 3
	    ELSE -1
    END AS delivery_status,
    late_delivery_risk,
    category_id,
    category_name,
    customer_city,
    CASE customer_country
        WHEN 'EE. UU.' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Puerto Rico' THEN 1
		ELSE -1
    END AS customer_country,
    customer_fname,
    customer_id,
    COALESCE(customer_lname, 'no last name provided') AS customer_lname,
    CASE customer_segment
        WHEN 'Consumer' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Corporate' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Home Office' THEN 2
        ELSE -1
    END AS customer_segment,
    CASE customer_state
        WHEN 'AL' THEN 0
        WHEN 'AR' THEN 1
        WHEN 'AZ' THEN 2
        WHEN 'CA' THEN 3
        WHEN '91732'  THEN 3
        WHEN '95758' THEN 3
        WHEN 'CO' THEN 4
        WHEN 'CT' THEN 5
        WHEN 'DC' THEN 6
        WHEN 'DE' THEN 7
        WHEN 'FL' THEN 8
        WHEN 'GA' THEN 9
        WHEN 'HI' THEN 10
        WHEN 'IA' THEN 11
        WHEN 'ID' THEN 12
        WHEN 'IL' THEN 13
        WHEN 'IN' THEN 14
        WHEN 'KS' THEN 15
        WHEN 'KY' THEN 16
        WHEN 'LA' THEN 17
        WHEN 'MA' THEN 18
        WHEN 'MD' THEN 19
        WHEN 'MI' THEN 20
        WHEN 'MN' THEN 21
        WHEN 'MO' THEN 22
        WHEN 'MT' THEN 23
        WHEN 'NC' THEN 24
        WHEN 'ND' THEN 25
        WHEN 'NJ' THEN 26
        WHEN 'NM' THEN 27
        WHEN 'NV' THEN 28
        WHEN 'NY' THEN 29
        WHEN 'OH' THEN 30
        WHEN 'OK' THEN 31
        WHEN 'OR' THEN 32
        WHEN 'PA' THEN 33
        WHEN 'PR' THEN 34
        WHEN 'RI' THEN 35
        WHEN 'SC' THEN 36
        WHEN 'TN' THEN 37
        WHEN 'TX' THEN 38
        WHEN 'UT' THEN 39
        WHEN 'VA' THEN 40
        WHEN 'WA' THEN 41
        WHEN 'WI' THEN 42
        WHEN 'WV' THEN 43
        ELSE -1
    END AS customer_state,
    customer_street,
    COALESCE(customer_zipcode, '00000') AS customer_zipcode,
    department_id,
    CASE department_name
        WHEN 'Apparel' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Book Shop' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Discs Shop' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Fan Shop' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Fitness' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Footwear' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Golf' THEN 6
        WHEN 'Health and Beauty ' THEN 7
        WHEN 'Outdoors' THEN 8
        WHEN 'Pet Shop' THEN 9
        WHEN 'Technology' THEN 10
        ELSE -1
    END AS department_name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    CASE market
        WHEN 'Africa' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Europe' THEN 1
        WHEN 'LATAM' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Pacific Asia' THEN 3
        WHEN 'USCA' THEN 4
	    ELSE -1
    END AS market,
    order_city,
    order_country,
    order_customer_id,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    order_item_cardprod_id,
    order_Item_discount,
    order_item_discount_rate,
    order_item_id,
    order_item_product_price,
    order_item_profit_ratio,
    order_item_quantity,
    sales,
    order_item_total,
    order_profit_per_order,
    CASE order_region
        WHEN 'Canada' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Caribbean' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Central Africa' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Central America' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Central Asia' THEN 4
        WHEN 'East Africa' THEN 5
        WHEN 'East of USA' THEN 6
        WHEN 'Eastern Asia' THEN 7
        WHEN 'Eastern Europe' THEN 8
        WHEN 'North Africa' THEN 9
        WHEN 'Northern Europe' THEN 10
        WHEN 'Oceania' THEN 11
        WHEN 'South America' THEN 12
        WHEN 'South Asia' THEN 13
        WHEN 'South of  USA ' THEN 14
        WHEN 'Southeast Asia' THEN 15
        WHEN 'Southern Africa' THEN 16
        WHEN 'Southern Europe' THEN 17
        WHEN 'US Center ' THEN 18
        WHEN 'West Africa' THEN 19
        WHEN 'West Asia' THEN 20
        WHEN 'West of USA ' THEN 21
        WHEN 'Western Europe' THEN 22
	    ELSE -1
    END AS order_region,
    order_state,
    CASE order_status
        WHEN 'CANCELED' THEN 0
        WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 1
        WHEN 'COMPLETE' THEN 2
        WHEN 'ON_HOLD' THEN 3
        WHEN 'PAYMENT_REVIEW' THEN 4
        WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 5
        WHEN 'PENDING_PAYMENT' THEN 6
        WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 7
        WHEN 'SUSPECTED_FRAUD' THEN 8
	    ELSE -1
    END AS order_status,
    COALESCE(order_zipcode, '00000') AS order_zipcode,
    product_card_id,
    product_category_id,
    product_image,
    product_name,
    product_price,
    shipping_date,
    CASE shipping_mode 
        WHEN 'First Class' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Same Day' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Second Class' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Standard Class' THEN 3
	    ELSE -1
    END AS shipping_mode
FROM FLOWFILE

SELECT
	record_id,
    transaction_type,
    actual_days_to_ship,
    scheduled_days_to_ship,
    benefit_per_order,
    sales_per_customer,
    delivery_status,
    late_delivery_risk,
    category_id,
    category_name,
    customer_city,
    customer_country,
    customer_fname,
    customer_id,
    customer_lname,
    customer_segment,
    customer_state,
    customer_street,
    customer_zipcode,
    department_id,
    department_name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    market,
    order_city,
    order_country,
    order_customer_id,
    order_date,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS order_date_day,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS order_date_month,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS order_date_year,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS order_date_day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS order_date_week_of_year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS order_date_quarter,
    order_id,
    order_item_cardprod_id,
    order_Item_discount,
    order_item_discount_rate,
    order_item_id,
    order_item_product_price,
    order_item_profit_ratio,
    order_item_quantity,
    sales,
    order_item_total,
    order_profit_per_order,
    order_region,
    order_state,
    order_status,
    order_zipcode,
    product_card_id,
    product_category_id,
    product_image,
    product_name,
    product_price,
    shipping_date,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(shipping_date AS DATE)) AS shipping_date_day,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(shipping_date AS DATE)) AS shipping_date_month,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(shipping_date AS DATE)) AS shipping_date_year,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(shipping_date AS DATE)) AS shipping_date_day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(shipping_date AS DATE)) AS shipping_date_week_of_year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(shipping_date AS DATE)) AS shipping_date_quarter,
    shipping_mode,
	(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(shipping_date AS DATE)) AS INT) - CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS INT)) / 86400 AS days_to_ship_since_order
FROM FLOWFILE
